name: wsystem/einvoice
description: Create and validate EU e-invoices locally in PHP: XRechnung 3.0 (UBL and CII), EN 16931 UBL/CII and ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF/A-3. Offline, no API key. Official KoSIT/CEN rules via SaxonC, a pure-PHP pre-check otherwise.

suggest.ext-saxon: SaxonC-HE PHP extension: runs the official EN 16931 / XRechnung schematron (XSLT 2.0) in-process, identical to KoSIT
suggest.wsystem/wsystem-php: Hosted W System API client: VIES VAT checks, Peppol routing, sending
